name: Krampus Celebrant OLD
source: Pathfinder Lost Omens Monsters of Myth

defensiveAbilities.name: Frightful Presence
defensiveAbilities.description:
30 feet. DC 23 Will Saving Throw

See rules...

A creature that first enters the area must attempt a Will save.

Regardless of the result of the saving throw, the creature is temporarily immune to this monster's Frightful Presence for 1 minute.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected by the presence.

Success The creature is Frightened 1.

Failure The creature is Frightened 2.

Critical Failure The creature is Frightened 4.

offensiveAbilities.name: Frightful Parade
offensiveAbilities.description: The Krampus celebrant Strides up to its Speed and attempts a birch bundle Strike against one creature within its reach at any point during that movement.

offensiveAbilities.name: Relentless Torment
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The Krampus celebrant hits a frightened creature with its birch bundle Strike

Effect The target must attempt a DC 26 Will Saving Throw save to resist the effects of the fearful assault.

Success The target is unaffected.

Failure The creature takes 1d8 Mental Damage damage. At the end of the creature's next turn, its frightened condition doesn't decrease by 1.

Critical Failure The creature takes 2d8 Mental Damage damage, and its frightened condition increases by 1 (maximum 4). At the end of its next turn, its frightened condition doesn't decrease by 1.

offensiveAbilities.name: Snowstride
offensiveAbilities.description: The Krampus celebrant ignores difficult terrain caused by snow and ice, and it treats greater difficult terrain caused by snow and ice as difficult terrain.

offensiveAbilities.name: Vandal
offensiveAbilities.description: Whenever the Krampus celebrant deals damage to an object, it ignores the first 10 points of the object's Hardness.

offensiveAbilities.name: Grab
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Grab in its damage entry, or the monster has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

Effect If used after a Strike, the monster attempts to Grapple the creature using the body part it attacked with. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the creature's multiple attack penalty.

The monster can instead use Grab and choose one creature it's grabbing or restraining with an appendage that has Grab to automatically extend that condition to the end of the monster's next turn.

cantrips.name: Tanglefoot
cantrips.description:
A vine covered in sticky sap appears from thin air, flicking from your hand and lashing itself to the target. Attempt a spell attack against the target.

Critical Success The target gains the Immobilized condition and takes a –10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds for 1 round. It can attempt to Escape against your spell DC to remove the penalty and the Immobilized condition.

Success The target takes a –10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds for 1 round. It can attempt to Escape against your spell DC to remove the penalty.

Failure The target is unaffected.

Heightened (2nd) The effects last for 2 rounds.

Heightened (4th) The effects last for 1 minute.

lv2spells.name: Obscuring Mist
lv2spells.description: You call forth a cloud of mist. All creatures within the mist become Concealed, and all creatures outside the mist become Concealed to creatures within it. You can Dismiss the cloud.
